$comment: Task colours and accents in Concept E: light fills and ahead rings (ED-155, ED-161), dark fills that are also the dark rings (ED-175). Brown, plum and olive are ED-161's new keys (ED-219), their dark values the approved ones; listed in ED-161's picker order; a custom colour is any #RRGGBB in color_key (ED-220), not listed here. Accents (ED-360): teal is the default; indigo, coral and violet take their Concept E shades, coral the ring shade #DF6147 because its fill is under 3:1 on the ground; buttons derive a darker or lighter shade for text. Order is the picker order. Edit here, then run: dart run tool/gen_task_palette.dart
$legacyComment: Keys from the 12-colour palette (docs/03 §1, M1.0) that may still be stored; they render as the mapped colour and are never written by the app (ADR-0007).
